# Norm

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Norm>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

A prescription existing by social convention — an obligation, prohibition, permission, or recommendation issued by an agent or standpoint over some conduct. A norm asserts nothing about the world: it records that an issuer prescribes. Whether anything complies is a vantage-indexed [`ComplianceAssessment`](gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md); what wins when norms conflict is solver work over the recorded precedence claims ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Every modality-bearing norm must name its issuer (SHACL): there is no ought, only ought-according-to (Principles 1, 9). GROUNDING: a [gufo:Category](../../external/terms.md#gufo-category) at [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) level — the [`IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md) precedent — because the graft places [`gmeow:Rule`](gmeow-Rule.md) (⊑ [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)) beneath it while plain standalone norms are object-like social descriptions; committing [`Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md) to [gufo:Object](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object) OR [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator) would make one branch inconsistent (Object ⟂ Aspect), and a Kind would stack identities under the rights trio (OntoUML MixIden). The social-convention reading lives on the concrete classes: [`NormativeSystem`](gmeow-NormativeSystem.md) ⊑ [`SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md), the trio ⊑ Relator.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
